bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are set to open their 2026 season Sunday against the Carolina Panthers in Charlotte, with the team recently signing running back D'Andre Swift to a three-year extension through 2029 The Chicago Bears have announced that the club has signed running back D'Andre Swift to a three-year extension through 2029. Ahead of the opener, the Bears also elevated quarterback Miller Moss and wide receiver Kaden Davis from the practice squad, while receiver Rome Odunze's return to practice from a calf injury and Luther Burden III's expected return from a groin injury provide positive news on the injury front The Chicago Bears have announced that the club has signed quarterback Miller Moss to the Practice Squad and has elevated Moss and wide receiver Kaden Davis from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are preparing for their 2026 season opener against the New Orleans Saints, with head coach Dan Campbell confirming the team will likely have Christian Mahogany start at left guard against the Saints after an ongoing competition with Ben Bartch. Detroit also bolstered its roster ahead of Week 1 by signing Tom Kennedy to the active roster , with Dave Fipp confirming he'll handle punt return duties as the Lions look to build on last season's success against a Saints team dealing with several banged-up starters.
